rows.jp: いろいろ動き回ってみた。
rows.en: I ran around trying one thing after another.

ghs.en: I tried going around in all sorts of ways.

rows.jp: 日曜日の部活。
rows.en: Sunday club activities.

rows.jp: 世界最後の日に、皆で大団円を迎えるため。
rows.en: So we could all arrive at a grand finale together on the world's last day.

ghs.en: I want for everyone to welcome the grand finale on the last day of this world together.

rows.jp: だけど……困難さを感じた。
rows.en: But... I could already feel how hard that would be.

rows.jp: 全員を和姦……じゃなくて和解させるには、そーとーなパズルが必要だ。
rows.en: To get everyone to make out... no, make up, I'd need one hell of a puzzle.

ghs.en: To sex all of us... no, wait, to see all of us reconciled, there is one biiig puzzle to solve.
ghs.assessment: The source slips from 'reconcile everyone' into a homophonically similar term for consensual sex, then corrects itself. 'To sex all of us' is not grammatical English and makes the speaker both agent and participant rather than preserving the slip.
ghs.remedy: To get everyone consensually laid... no, reconciled

highlights.text: To sex all of us... no, wait, to see all of us reconciled

rows.jp: 祠に向かう。
rows.en: I headed for the shrine.

rows.jp: 大量のノート。
rows.en: A mass of notebooks.

rows.jp: 読み切れないほどの分量だ。
rows.en: More than I could possibly finish reading.

ghs.en: An amount great enough that I could never read through all.
ghs.assessment: The phrasal verb requires an object such as 'it all' or 'all of them.'
ghs.remedy: I could never read through it all.

highlights.text: I could never read through all.

rows.jp: 美希を手込め（表現に）にすると、霧がダメになる。
rows.en: If I had my way with Miki—figuratively speaking—Kiri would be finished.

ghs.en: With Miki forced into copulation against her will (figuratively), Kiri spoils.

rows.jp: 情報が増えるのは良いことだ。
rows.en: More information was a good thing.

ghs.en: An increase in information is a very good thing,

rows.jp: けど増えすぎると、解析する時間がなくなる。
rows.en: But too much of it, and I'd run out of time to analyze it all.

ghs.en: but with an excessive increase, the time for accurate study vanishes.

rows.jp: ジレンマだ。
rows.en: A dilemma.

rows.jp: 俺は夜中まで、頭を捻り続けた。
rows.en: I kept racking my brain until the middle of the night.

ghs.en: I continued to rack my brains over it until the dead of night.

rows.jp: 「太一」
rows.en: “Taichi.”

rows.jp: 背後から、ライトがつく。
rows.en: A light came on behind me.

ghs.en: A light appears from behind me.

rows.jp: 懐中電灯だ。
rows.en: A flashlight.

rows.jp: そして曜子ちゃんだ。
rows.en: And Yoko.

rows.jp: 「んあ……明るい……」
rows.en: “Ngh... Bright...”

rows.jp: 「いくらその目でも、文字を読んでたら悪くするから」
rows.en: “Even with eyes like yours, reading in the dark will make them worse.”

ghs.en: Youko: "Even those eyes you have will go bad if you read text."

rows.jp: 「ん……ごめん」
rows.en: “Mm... Sorry.”

rows.jp: 「なにか発見はあった？」
rows.en: “Did you find anything?”

rows.jp: 「ない。知恵の輪に延々とハマってるみたいだ」
rows.en: “No. It feels like I've been stuck on one of those metal-ring puzzles forever.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "None. It's like being endlessly stuck with a puzzle ring."

rows.jp: 「そう、残念ね」
rows.en: “I see. That's too bad.”

rows.jp: 「曜子ちゃんはこのノートを……」
rows.en: “Yoko, these notebooks...”

rows.jp: 問いかけて、口をつぐむ。
rows.en: I started to ask, then stopped myself.

ghs.en: I begin to ask the question, then shut my mouth.

rows.jp: 彼女に頼ることだろうか。
rows.en: Was I really going to rely on her?

ghs.en: Should I really be relying on her?

rows.jp: 「いいや。帰ろう」
rows.en: “No. Let's go home.”

rows.jp: 立ち上がる。
rows.en: I stood up.

rows.jp: ノートは一応、祠にしまう。
rows.en: For the time being, I put the notebooks back in the shrine.

ghs.en: For now, the notebooks stay shut away in the hokora.

rows.jp: 何冊かは手にする。読める分は。
rows.en: I took a few with me—the ones I could manage to read.

ghs.en: I keep a number of them at hand. No more than I can read.

rows.jp: 「……一緒に帰っても、いい？」
rows.en: “...Can I walk home with you?”

rows.jp: 「いっつも監視してるくせに」
rows.en: “As if you don't watch me all the time.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "When you're always, always keeping me under surveillance anyway!"

rows.jp: 「ごめんなさい……」
rows.en: “I'm sorry...”
